bio.summary: Completed a PhD at the University of Michigan in 2025 with Kang G. Shin as committee chair. The dissertation, 'Exploring the Effects of Memory Vulnerabilities Across the Computer Architecture Stack', covers reverse-engineering memory-controller address mapping, combining Rowhammer with microarchitectural exploits, Rowhammer threats to software patterns, and end-to-end Rowhammer attack efficiency. Co-authored SpecHammer (IEEE S&P 2022) and Go Go Gadget Hammer (USENIX Security 2024), and acknowledges being hosted at Lincoln Lab.
